title: Tuna onigiri with nori
steps: Wash the rice and cook it with 160 ml water for 12 minutes, rest for 10 minutes and let it cool slightly.
Mix the tuna with the yoghurt and soy sauce.
Wet and salt your hands, flatten a portion of rice, put tuna in the middle and shape into triangles (4 pieces).
Wrap with nori strips and sprinkle with sesame.
